gen-dafont-electroharmonix-gf-anek-latin: Electroharmonix breaks every word into separate, gappy letters, with generous curves in each round character that give it a commanding look. Anek Latin keeps lowercase nearly level with the capitals, curves left open.
gen-dafont-electroharmonix-gf-anek-telug: Wide gaps chop each word into individual letters, and Electroharmonix rounds every curve with an open hand. Anek Telugu reads smoothly line after line, its wide bowls staying unsealed and friendly.
gen-dafont-electroharmonix-gf-arimo: Open gaps split every word into separate letters in Electroharmonix, and its round characters curve with an open hand. Give Arimo a comfortable body size so its spacious terminal gaps show.
gen-dafont-electroharmonix-gf-chivo: Loud, gappy and open-handed, Electroharmonix grabs attention first. Electroharmonix does its best work spacing out single letters, while Chivo, a sans-serif, packs lowercase up toward the caps with daylight in every curve.
gen-dafont-electroharmonix-gf-chocolate-: Electroharmonix comes in loud, with gaps splitting each word apart. Chocolate Classical Sans then supplies a sizable body of broad-nibbed pen strokes that never curl shut, which softens the heading's shout.
gen-dafont-electroharmonix-gf-cossette-t: Cossette Texte reads clean, its lowercase e wide-eyed and prominent. Paragraphs in it flow without snags, since each n arch carries the same weight as its stems, while Electroharmonix handles the gappy shouting.
gen-dafont-electroharmonix-gf-fresca: Gaps break each word of Electroharmonix into separate letters. It is most at home large and short, while Fresca keeps one constant line width and short ascenders above big bowls.
gen-dafont-electroharmonix-gf-gafata: Gafata sets a high band of letters beneath short stalks. Give it a moderate body size so the wide-eyed e keeps its look, and let Electroharmonix handle the gappy shouting above.
gen-dafont-electroharmonix-gf-hedvig-let: Wide gaps pull each Electroharmonix word apart letter by letter, curves open-handed throughout. Hedvig Letters Sans then brings a clear wide gap where the c ends, with small letters standing close to capital height.
gen-dafont-electroharmonix-gf-heebo: Open gaps between letters and generous curves define Electroharmonix, a display face. Heebo does the quieter job, holding a central band of text with curves that stop short instead of closing.
